sloka: रजतम् वा सुवर्णम् वा शुभानि आभरणानि च ।अविभक्तानि साधूनाम् अवगच्छन्ति साधवः ॥४-८-७॥
transliteration: rajatam vā suvarṇam vā śubhāni ābharaṇāni ca ।avibhaktāni sādhūnām avagacchanti sādhavaḥ ॥4-8-7॥

translations.english: 'Good friends consider(valuables such as) silver or gold, clothes or ornaments of worldly wealth indivisible.
